nav.sectionText:
ADDITIONAL ORIGINAL MEASUREMENTS · FIGSHARE V2
NaV current and TTX inhibition

Two additional source tables: 56 control/TTX current-density rows and 28 deposited inhibition-percentage rows. These 84 measurements do not count independent cells or animals.

Native labels repeat: cervical Cell 11 occurs twice per condition and twice in the percentage table. Source percentages span 93–143.1%; values and labels are retained. No rows are paired across or within these tables.
